# hivelocity_product (Data Source)

Look up a product (server plan) and its per-location stock and pricing from the public inventory. Filter on any attribute, for example `product_memory`, `data_center` or `stock`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_product" "tampa" {
  filter {
    name   = "data_center"
    values = ["TPA1"]
  }
}

output "tampa_product" {
  value = data.hivelocity_product.tampa
}

data "hivelocity_product" "all" {}

output "first_product" {
  value = data.hivelocity_product.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `annually_location_premium` (Number)
- `biennial_location_premium` (Number)
- `core` (Boolean) True if core site.
- `data_center` (String) A facility code. For example `NYC1`.
- `edge` (Boolean) True if edge site.
- `hourly_location_premium` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_disk_upgradable` (Boolean) True if the product has multiple disk upgrade options.
- `is_sps` (Boolean) True if this is an SPS (instant) product.
- `is_vds` (Boolean) True if this VPS product is VDS type.
- `is_vps` (Boolean) True if this is a VPS product.
- `location_option_id` (Number) Location option ID for the data center.
- `monthly_location_premium` (Number)
- `oos_lead_time_days` (Number) Lead time in days for out-of-stock ordering.
- `oos_ordering_available` (Boolean) True if out-of-stock ordering is available at this location.
- `product_annually_price` (Number)
- `product_bandwidth` (String)
- `product_biennial_price` (Number)
- `product_cpu` (String)
- `product_cpu_cores` (String)
- `product_disabled_billing_periods` (List of String) Orders for these billing periods will fail.
- `product_display_price` (Number)
- `product_drive` (String)
- `product_gpu` (String)
- `product_hourly_price` (Number)
- `product_id` (Number) The unique ID of this product.
- `product_memory` (String)
- `product_monthly_price` (Number)
- `product_name` (String) The unique name of this product.
- `product_new` (Boolean) True if the product is newly released.
- `product_on_sale` (Boolean)
- `product_original_price` (Number)
- `product_quarterly_price` (Number)
- `product_semi_annually_price` (Number)
- `product_triennial_price` (Number)
- `quarterly_location_premium` (Number)
- `semi_annually_location_premium` (Number)
- `stock` (String) available|limited|unavailable.
- `triennial_location_premium` (Number)

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
